rows.meaning: person who is no longer married
rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose description of a marriage that has legally ended or a person whose marriage has ended.

example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 ji5 ging1 lei4 fan1 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when something or someone is cut off from reality, not for marital status.

example.english: You are always lost in fantasies and really divorced from reality.
example.traditional: 你成日沉迷喺幻想入面，真係脫離現實喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 cam4 mai4 hai2 waan6 soeng2 jap6 min6 zan1 hai6 tyut3 lei4 jin6 sat6 wo3
